design_summary: The user authentication module will be implemented in pure Python using a dictionary-based storage for simplicity. The module will handle email validation, password strength checks, PBKDF2 hashing, and HMAC-SHA256 signing. Rate-limiting will be implemented using a rolling window.

tasks.description: Implement the user registration functionality with email validation and password strength checks.
Implement the user login functionality with HMAC-SHA256 signing and rate-limiting.

test_strategy: Unit tests will cover the registration and login functionality. Integration tests will verify that the module can be used in a real-world application. Acceptance tests will ensure that all acceptance criteria are met.
